description: The contributing Belgian research institutions publish input and output files for a study combining Sentinel-1 radar and Landsat 8 optical imagery to map built-up areas in sub-Saharan Africa. The named Zenodo deposit links the study and its separately hosted source code, and supplies a compressed data package under CC BY 4.0. The same product is cited as an input in the Dakar population-mapping article. Infrastructure simulation modellers can reuse built-up classifications and associated inputs to compare settlement representations or prepare demand and exposure surfaces. Coverage is study-specific within sub-Saharan Africa, not a complete continental building inventory. The landing-page description does not enumerate all scene dates or internal file formats, and archive contents were not downloaded. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Complementarity Between Sentinel-1 And Landsat 8 Imagery For Built-Up Mapping In Sub-Saharan Africa
notes: G4-0424; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
provider: Université Libre de Bruxelles, Belgian Royal Military Academy and Université de Namur
